messages:
sam (AE): Heads up: FinEdge sent an RFI focused on identity controls. They want SAML SP metadata, confirmation of MFA enforcement options (console, CLI, API), list of default roles and permissions, and a signed statement about least-privilege defaults. POC kickoff Wed. Can we compile an "IAM package" by Tues EOD?

priya (SE): Yes. I'll pull the SP metadata and add an example SAML assertion. Do we have a public SP metadata URL we can share or do we need to generate a temporary export?

matt (InfoSec): We publish SP metadata at https://console.redwood.ai/saml/metadata (valid xml). For customers who require it, we can also provide a signed export PDF. MFA: we don't enforce MFA server-side for API keys, but we require IdP-enforced MFA for console logins when SSO is enabled. For programmatic access we recommend short-lived tokens via federated sessions or scoped API keys with expirations.

clara (Solutions): FinEdge specifically asked whether CLI auth can be gated by MFA. Answer: interactive CLI login flows rely on browser-based SSO so MFA is enforced by the IdP; non-interactive automation should use ephemeral tokens. I'll draft a short note with that guidance.

priya (SE): I'll attach a small how-to for creating a scoped key via the API and a sample policy JSON for a read-only project role.

priya (SE): sample snippet:
```
POST /v1/orgs/{org_id}/api-keys
{
  "name": "finedge-poc-readonly",
  "scopes": ["models.view","jobs.list"],
  "expires_in": "72h"
}
```

matt (InfoSec): For RBAC, default roles: org-owner, org-auditor, project-admin, developer, viewer. I'll export the role-permission matrix (CSV) and a one-page excerpt from our Access Management policy. Also preparing a signed attestation: "Redwood Inference provisions organizations with least-privilege default roles; elevated privileges require explicit assignment. Customers can enforce SSO and MFA at their IdP; programmatic access is provided via scoped, expirational tokens."

files-bot: New share created: https://files.redwood.ai/share/finedge-iam-package (id: a9d3b2)

clara (Solutions): Adding a short checklist for the customer: how to enable SSO, require IdP MFA, create scoped API keys, review role assignments. I'll put a 1-page how-to in the folder.

matt (InfoSec): Uploads complete: sp-metadata.xml, roles-permissions.csv, mfa-guidance.pdf, signed-attestation.pdf, cli-auth-notes.md, api-scope-example.md -> https://files.redwood.ai/share/finedge-iam-package

sam (AE): This is fantastic. I'll attach the links to the RFI and schedule the POC kickoff Wed 9am PT. If they ask for SOC2 workpapers, we'll route to Legal for redaction. Thanks everyone. :tada:
